title: Online and Mobile Banking Scams: What to Watch for and How to Stay Safe
summary: Protect your finances from online and mobile banking scams. Learn warning signs, fraud prevention tips, and ways to keep your accounts secure.
body_markdown:
# Online and Mobile Banking Scams: What to Watch for and How to Stay Safe


Online and mobile banking make it easier than ever to manage your money; however, as digital tools evolve, so do the tactics scammers use to target customers.


Understanding the most common online banking scams and mobile banking scams can help you stay secure while using Landmark National Bank’s digital services. Let’s review a few simple habits that will go a long way in strengthening your digital banking security.


## Common Online & Mobile Banking Scams


Scammers often try to mimic legitimate banking activity to trick customers into sharing personal information or login credentials. The most frequent threats include:


- Fake login pages or spoofed websites that look nearly identical to your bank’s site.
- Phishing emails claiming there’s suspicious activity on your account.
- Text message verification scams asking you to confirm a code you didn’t request.
- Fraudulent mobile apps designed to steal your username and password.
- Malware or spyware that captures keystrokes or login details on infected devices.


These scams are designed to create urgency and push you to act before you have time to think.


## Warning Signs to Watch For


Recognizing account takeover scams early can prevent major financial damage. Red flags include:


- Unexpected login alerts or password reset messages.
- Links that don’t match your bank’s official website.
- Requests for your full password, PIN, or verification codes.
- App downloads from outside the Apple App Store or Google Play Store.
- Messages that pressure you to act immediately.


If something feels off, trust your instincts and verify directly with your bank. A quick call to confirm if the communications you’re receiving are legitimate can save you countless hours of problem-solving.


## How to Protect Your Online Banking


A few simple habits can significantly improve your[digital banking security](https://www.banklandmark.com/personal/online-mobile/) and help you avoid online banking scams:


- Use strong, unique passwords for your banking accounts.
- Enable multi‑factor authentication (MFA) for an extra layer of protection.
- Keep your phone, computer, and apps updated to patch security vulnerabilities.
- Avoid logging in on public Wi‑Fi, especially in airports, hotels, or coffee shops.
- Regularly monitor your accounts through online or mobile banking.


These safe mobile banking tips help ensure your information stays protected, even as scammers switch their tactics.


## What to Do If You Suspect Fraud


If you think your account has been targeted by mobile banking scams or online banking scams, take action right away.


- Immediately[contact your bank](https://www.banklandmark.com/about-us/contact-us/) using official contact information.
- Change your online banking password and enable MFA if it isn’t already on.
- Review recent transactions for unfamiliar activity.
- Check your device for suspicious apps or software.


Quick action helps prevent account takeover scams and supports a faster resolution.

Enable account alerts and multi‑factor authentication through online banking today. Only download official banking apps from trusted app stores. If you suspect suspicious activity,[contact Landmark](https://www.banklandmark.com/about-us/contact-us/) immediately for personal guidance.
